name: calSuppressAndInspire
description: Inspire/Suppress probability layer for pal (partner) and cannon damage. Structurally identical to calArmorAndBlock but uses partner-specific attributes. Randomly determines whether attacker inspires (reduces resistance) or defender suppresses (increases resistance).

parameters.resistance: Base resistance value to modify (partner_resist or season_cannon_att_def)
parameters.attrib_key: The attribute key for the resistance (used for up_limit config lookup)

formula_steps.description: Build probability ranges for inspire and suppress
Calculate inspire probability (only if partner_inspire > ignore_partner_inspire)
formula_steps.note: Despite the name, inspire triggers the suppress_rate probability (attacker's inspire uses partner_suppress_rate from attacker)

formula_steps.description: Calculate suppress probability (only if partner_suppress > ignore_partner_suppress), stacked after inspire range
formula_steps.formula: if (partner_suppress > ignore_partner_suppress): ranges[1] = ranges[0] + roundInt(10000 * partner_inspire_rate)
formula_steps.note: Suppress triggers the inspire_rate probability (defender's suppress uses partner_inspire_rate from defender)

formula_steps.description: Roll random number and determine outcome
formula_steps.formula: rand = randomInt(0, 10000); if rand <= ranges[0]: outcome = Inspire(0); else if rand <= ranges[1]: outcome = Suppress(1); else: outcome = Neither(2)

formula_steps.description: Apply inspire or suppress to resistance

Inspire (outcome=0).note: Reduces resistance; inspire amount capped at 0.5 (50%)

Suppress (outcome=1).note: Increases resistance; suppress amount capped at 0.5 (50%)

formula_steps.description: Apply up_limit cap from attribute config
formula_steps.formula: if (config.up_limit != 0): cap = (config.num_type == 2) ? round(up_limit / 10000) : up_limit; resistance = min(resistance, cap)

notes: Inspire and suppress are mutually exclusive per hit — only one can trigger
The attribute cross-reference is noteworthy: inspire condition uses attacker's partner_inspire vs defender's ignore_partner_inspire, but the probability uses attacker's partner_suppress_rate
Similarly, suppress condition uses defender's partner_suppress vs attacker's ignore_partner_suppress, but the probability uses defender's partner_inspire_rate
The up_limit is read from the attribute metadata config of the resistance attribute
